name: Jupiter Wagons Limited
summary: Jupiter Wagons Limited manufactures and sells railway wagons, wagon components, and railway transportation equipment in India and internationally. It provides open, covered, flat, hopper, container, and special purpose wagons; and wagon accessories, such as alloy steel cast bogies, high tensile center buffer couplers, and high-capacity draft gears. The company also offers train sets, passenger, and metro coaches; and passenger coach accessories, including fabricated bogies, couplers and draft gears for passenger trains, axle mounted disc brake systems, brake discs and split brake discs, and brake pads.
